hub.speaker: Peddler
hub.text: Watch gear, mostly honest. Mostly. The gambeson's clean. The bow I'd not ask about.

options.text: That bow strung up back there. Practice grade. (8 gold)
One of those trap kits the Watch keeps mentioning. (3 gold)

bought.speaker: Peddler
bought.text: Deposit's already paid, so don't ask where it came from. Wear it in good health. More under the tarp.
